name: Hishiki Saeko
source:
Class: 2-A

The student council president and a well-behaved honor student. Her cleverness is also her greatest enemy, as she can't feel enthusiastic about anything.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=804105]Getchu[/url]]
